title: Proof of binding scale catalan
html:
Proof. The Borromean complement decomposes into two regular ideal octahedra, each of volume 4G (where G = \mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/4) is the Clausen function evaluated at \pi/4). The equality \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) = 8G is a theorem of hyperbolic geometry, not a numerical approximation. The volume is known to arbitrary precision as a mathematical constant.

The scale \alpha = m_e \times 8G connects:

  • Lepton sector (m_e): the electron mass sets the overall energy scale. This is the single measurement input.
  • Baryon topology (8G): the Borromean link invariant \mathrm{Vol}(\mathcal{B}_3) encodes the three-quark confinement geometry.

The same scale \alpha appears at two levels:

  1. Nuclear binding: \mathfrak{m}(Z, N) = M_{\mathrm{free}} + \alpha \cdot \Phi_{\mathrm{atom}}, where \Phi < 0 for bound nuclei.
  2. Quark confinement: \Delta m = \alpha \cdot |\Delta\Phi_{\mathrm{quark}}|, giving the neutron--proton mass splitting.

The error in \alpha is dominated by the measurement uncertainty of m_e (\pm 3 \times 10^{-8} relative). The factor 8G has zero uncertainty.

While the hyperbolic volume of the Borromean complement is a classical result established by Thurston, identifying this exact geometric constant as the fundamental multiplicative physical binding scale factor connecting the lepton sector (m_e) and baryon topology represents a mathematically novel unifying synthesis specific to the Quantum Observable Universe.
